question: The Bandipur National Park is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bandipur National Park:-**

 
 
• **It is located in the state of Karnataka.**
 
• Bandipur National Park is one of the well-known national parks in India, situated in the southern part of the country.
 
• It is a part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, which is the largest protected forest area in India and one of the largest in the world.
 
• The park is known for its rich biodiversity and is home to several species of animals, including tigers, elephants, Indian bison, and deer.
 
• It is a popular tourist destination and attracts a large number of wildlife enthusiasts and nature lovers every year.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andhra Pradesh: **

 
 
• The state has several wildlife sanctuaries and national parks, including the Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve, Sri Venkateswara National Park, and Papikonda National Park.
 
 
 
• **Kerala**:
 
 
• The state is known for its backwaters, beaches, and hill stations. It has several wildlife reserves, including the Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary, Silent Valley National Park, and Wayanad Wildlife Sanctuary.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu: **
 
 
• The state has several national parks and wildlife sanctuaries, including Mudumalai National Park, Guindy National Park, and Gulf of Mannar Marine National Park. It is also home to the famous Nilgiri Mountain Railway.
